cases.prompt: Upgrade pipecat-ai from 1.7.0 to 1.9.0 in this repository.
cases.expected_output: Reads the pipecat-ai release notes for every release in the 1.7.0..1.9.0 range (and each pipecat* subpackage's notes), scans pyproject.toml/uv.lock and client/package.json, implements the migration per example, and runs the gap-analysis loop until clean.
assertions: Loaded nemotron-voice-agent-upgrade-pipecat/SKILL.md and ran the phases in order.
Read release notes for every release in the 1.7.0..1.9.0 range before editing.
Scanned both the Python (pyproject.toml/uv.lock) and client (client/package.json) dependency surfaces.
Iterated the gap-analysis loop until zero gaps and gated on uv sync, ruff, and pytest.

cases.prompt: Move this repo to the latest Pipecat release.
cases.expected_output: Auto-detects the current pipecat-ai version from pyproject.toml and uv.lock, resolves the latest release from the canonical pipecat releases page, and reads the notes across the range before migrating.
assertions: Auto-detected the current version from pyproject.toml/uv.lock rather than asking.
Resolved the latest release from the canonical pipecat-ai releases source.
Did not hardcode assumptions about companion packages.

cases.prompt: Bump Pipecat and its JavaScript client packages together and keep the RTVI contract intact.
cases.expected_output: Upgrades the Python pipecat-ai and the @pipecat-ai/* client packages in lockstep, migrates client/src RTVI usage, and gates on npm lint+build alongside the Python validation.
assertions: Upgraded the Python server and @pipecat-ai/* client packages in lockstep for the RTVI contract.
Discovered the client packages from client/package.json rather than assuming which exist.
Gated on npm lint+build in addition to the Python checks.

cases.prompt: Deploy the omni assistant on a workstation GPU.
cases.expected_output: The upgrade-pipecat skill does not activate because bringing up a Compose recipe is handled by nemotron-voice-agent-deploy.
assertions: Did not load or apply nemotron-voice-agent-upgrade-pipecat.
Recognized this as a deployment task.

cases.prompt: Change the default TTS voice for the multilingual assistant.
cases.expected_output: The upgrade-pipecat skill does not activate because changing a catalog default is a configuration change handled by nemotron-voice-agent-configure-pipeline.
assertions: Did not load or apply nemotron-voice-agent-upgrade-pipecat.
Recognized this as a configuration change.

cases.prompt: Upgrade numpy to the latest version in this repo.
cases.expected_output: The upgrade-pipecat skill does not activate because it is specific to pipecat-ai and its companion packages, not general dependency bumps.
assertions: Did not load or apply nemotron-voice-agent-upgrade-pipecat.
Recognized numpy is outside the pipecat-ai upgrade scope.
